// Whole-file sweep over all 21713 rolled-out ids. Two independent assertions:
//   .@eq      getitemname() still equals the Korean `Name:`  (string equality)
//   .@noleak  getitemname() is NOT the English name  (no EN leak without a RID)
// The second one is the property that actually matters, and it holds whatever the
// source file encoding was, so it is asserted for every id. The first one needs
// the Korean literal to survive this cp949 script, which is why 2 ids are left
// out of it - see the ENCODING_DEFECT note in p12_build_verifier.py.
//
// `sleep 1;` every 250 ids keeps the run under the ~65,535-command limit that
// aborts a script with "script:run_script_main: infinity loop"; .@ variables
// survive the yield.
OnSweep:
	.@eq = 0; .@eq_bad = 0; .@eq_skip = 0; .@noleak = 0; .@leak = 0;
